story.label: A day at your own pace

scenes.title: Imagine waking up without checking the time.

scenes.title: Your coffee can wait a little.
scenes.text: Maybe you'd rather spend a few more minutes looking at the view.

seasons.title: What kind of trip is on your mind?
seasons.text: Maybe you want the cold, the green after the rain, or days close to the sea. Pick a season and find places that match it.

items.name: Autumn
items.text: For when you want warmth, golden landscapes and slow afternoons.

image.alt: White church steeple surrounded by red and golden maples in Stowe, Vermont

items.name: Winter
items.text: For enjoying the cold, staying close to the fireplace and sleeping in a little.

image.alt: Snowy village of Zermatt with the Matterhorn rising behind it

items.name: Spring
items.text: For spending more time outdoors and finding landscapes that change with every path.

image.alt: Green rolling fields with trees and a winding road in Val d'Orcia

items.name: Summer
items.text: For long days, staying close to the water and doing everything without a set schedule.

image.alt: Turquoise cove and stone boathouses at Cala s'Almunia, Mallorca

stays.title: Places that may fit your plans.
stays.text: Here are a few options to start picturing your next trip.

items.name: Inn among the maples
items.text: Golden hills, quiet roads and warm evenings by the window.
items.keywords: stowe vermont vt usa new england autumn fall maple foliage inn mountains

image.alt: Aerial view of Stowe surrounded by autumn hills and mountains

gallery.alt: Golden autumn trees near the Trapp Family Lodge in Stowe
Bright chalet living room with tall windows in Stowe

items.about: A small inn among the maples, a few minutes from the village of Stowe. In October the hills around turn red and gold.
items.arrive: About 45 minutes by car from Burlington airport.

host.name: Margaret
host.line: Runs the inn with her sister and bakes the maple scones every morning.

reviewsList.name: Hannah
reviewsList.text: The hills turned red while we were there. Breakfast by the window every morning.

reviewsList.name: Daniel
reviewsList.text: A short drive to the trails and quiet enough to hear the creek at night.

reviewsList.name: Priya
reviewsList.text: Margaret gave us a hand drawn map of the back roads. Best part of the trip.

items.name: Cabin in the mountains
items.text: A quiet place to enjoy the cold, the view and your free time.
items.keywords: zermatt switzerland swiss alps matterhorn winter snow ski chalet cabin mountains

image.alt: Old wooden chalets on a snowy slope in Zermatt

gallery.alt: Snowy wooden chalets on a slope in Zermatt
The Matterhorn reflected in Lake Stellisee above Zermatt

items.about: An old larch chalet on a quiet slope above the village. The Matterhorn sits right in the window.
items.arrive: Zermatt is car free: take the train from Täsch, or from Zurich in about 3h30.

host.name: Andreas
host.line: A mountain guide who grew up in the village and keeps the fire ready.

reviewsList.name: Hannah
reviewsList.text: We woke up to fresh snow and never left the fireplace before noon.

reviewsList.name: Lukas
reviewsList.text: The Matterhorn fills the bedroom window. Ten minutes on foot to the station.

reviewsList.name: Sofia
reviewsList.text: Warm, quiet and simple. Andreas suggested a hut for lunch that we loved.

items.name: Farmhouse in the hills
items.text: Stone walls, cypress trees and long lunches outside.
items.keywords: val d'orcia orcia tuscany toscana italy siena pienza spring farmhouse countryside hills

image.alt: Brick farmhouse framed by cypress trees in Val d'Orcia

gallery.alt: Green rolling fields and a winding road in Val d'Orcia
Cypress lined road across golden fields in Val d'Orcia

items.about: A brick farmhouse among cypress trees, with a garden, an old olive grove and long views over the valley.

host.name: Giulia
host.line: Grows the olives on the farm and knows every cellar in the valley.

reviewsList.name: Luca and Sofia
reviewsList.text: Breakfast outside, cypress trees, and a whole afternoon with nothing planned.

reviewsList.name: Emma
reviewsList.text: Pienza is a short drive away. We came back every evening for sunset in the garden.

reviewsList.name: Tom
reviewsList.text: Thick stone walls kept it cool. The pool overlooks the whole valley.

items.name: House by the sea
items.text: A few steps from the water, with mornings that start slowly.
items.keywords: mallorca majorca spain balearic islands beach sea cove summer house mediterranean

image.alt: Small houses on a rocky slope above turquoise water in Mallorca

gallery.alt: Stone steps and flowers in a village street in Mallorca
Boats floating in the clear water of Cala Bóquer, Mallorca

items.about: A stone house on the rocks above a small cove, with the sea a few steps from the door.
items.arrive: About 1h by car from Palma airport.

host.name: Toni
host.line: A fisherman’s son who knows which cove is calm on each windy day.

reviewsList.name: Clara
reviewsList.text: We swam before breakfast every day. The terrace is the best seat on the island.

reviewsList.name: Oliver
reviewsList.text: The steps down to the cove are steep but worth it. House stays cool all day.

reviewsList.name: Inés
reviewsList.text: Toni left fresh bread and tomatoes from his garden. Simple and perfect.

items.name: Hut above the valley
items.text: A wooden hut on the meadow, with the peaks all around.
items.keywords: corvara alta badia dolomites dolomiti south tyrol italy alps mountains hut cabin winter summer

image.alt: Wooden hut with a picnic table on an alpine meadow in the Dolomites

gallery.alt: Corvara village under the Dolomite peaks

items.about: A small wooden hut on the meadows above Corvara. Trails start at the door in summer, ski slopes in winter.
items.arrive: About 2h by car from Innsbruck or Venice airports via the Val Badia.

host.name: Lukas
host.line: Ski instructor in winter, trail runner in summer, always around the valley.

reviewsList.name: Marco
reviewsList.text: Ski in the morning, wood stove in the afternoon. Exactly what we wanted.

reviewsList.name: Julia
reviewsList.text: The peaks glow pink at sunset right in front of the hut.

reviewsList.name: Sam
reviewsList.text: Small, warm and well thought out. The sauna nearby was a nice surprise.

items.name: Lodge by the lake
items.text: Early mornings on a quiet lake, with the boathouse at your door.
items.keywords: braies lago di braies prags pragser wildsee dolomites south tyrol italy lake lodge mountains summer

image.alt: Lodge and meadow by Lago di Braies under the Dolomites

gallery.alt: Wooden boat on the turquoise water of Lago di Braies
Boathouse on Lago di Braies with mountains behind

items.about: A family lodge on the shore of Lago di Braies. Row out before the day visitors arrive and come back for a long breakfast.
items.arrive: About 3h by car from Venice airport.

host.name: Anna and Paul
host.line: Third generation on the lake, they keep the boats ready at dawn.

reviewsList.name: James
reviewsList.text: The lake was all ours at seven in the morning. That alone was worth the trip.

reviewsList.name: Elena
reviewsList.text: Rowing out before the crowds, then a long breakfast. We did it every day.

reviewsList.name: Max
reviewsList.text: The loop around the lake starts at the door. Rooms are simple and very warm.

faq.title: Good to know before you choose.
faq.text: A few details help you plan the trip with more peace of mind.
items: You choose the destination, add your dates and the number of guests to see the places available.
Can I find a place for a special occasion?
Yes. You can explore places by season, type of setting and the features that make sense for your trip.
How do I know if a place is available?
Add the dates you want to check availability for your stay.
Change and cancellation terms depend on each place. Check the rules before confirming your booking.
